Chapter 317: Chapter 15 Lobbying, Well Water Does Not Violate River Water (Subscribe Please)_2

Although the Human Civilization Alliance has a dedicated marketplace app for selling all kinds of treasures,

some rare and precious treasures are often in short supply, and these exchange meetings exist for such rare and valuable items.

“This is actually pretty good,”

Lin Yuan thought of the weapons and treasures of several Different Species he had acquired on the Battlefields of Different Races, as well as the inheritance from the Eighth Layer Evolutionist Ou Yin.

Many of them were items he didn’t need.

Selling them directly to Human Civilization would be too much of a loss.

...

Instead, it would be possible to dispose of them through these exchange meetings.

“Are you now participating or not?”

Shi Feng asked.

“I’ll participate,”

Lin Yuan nodded.

The premise of his lack of interest in the Star Alliance conference was that it was unable to bring any benefit to himself.

But now, after hearing Shi Feng’s description, for Sixth-Level Citizens like them, participating in the Star Alliance conference could be very profitable.

“Hahahaha,”

Shi Feng laughed heartily.

“By the way, Shisan, do you need me to introduce you to those Star Domains that need votes?”

Shi Feng inquired.

If Lin Yuan had no Star Domains in mind to vote for, he could ‘sell’ his vote at a high price to those Star Domains that needed it.

“Thanks a lot, Brother Shi Feng,”

Lin Yuan replied seriously upon hearing this.

Arranging such connections was not something the ordinary Evolver could accomplish; it required someone with extensive connections.

“No need to thank me,”

“We are friends,”

Shi Feng waved his hand and then said, “Just wait for me a moment, Shisan.”

After Shi Feng finished speaking,

his figure disappeared from sight.

He obviously went to make contact.

Lin Yuan sat down and waited for a while.

A moment later,

Shi Feng reappeared.

Besides, a young man also appeared beside him.

“This is Shisan, you can discuss your Star Domain’s matters directly with him,” said Shi Feng casually.

“Mr. Shisan,”

The young man gave a slight bow to Lin Yuan and said, “My name is ‘Na Dan,’ from the Wangyue Starfield.”

“This time, the conflict between our Wangyue Starfield and the Golden Dragon Star Domain will be brought up at the Star Alliance conference.”

“At that time, we hope that Mr. Shisan will vote for our Wangyue Starfield.”

After speaking, the young man ‘Na Dan’ respectfully placed a piece of White Paper on the dining table.

“If Mr. Shisan agrees, the resources of treasures listed above will be your reward,”

With a slight bow to Shi Feng, the young man ‘Na Dan’ then stepped out of the personal space.

“Tsk tsk, Wangyue Starfield really has it tough. Less powerful than the Golden Dragon Star Domain, they can only seek help like this…”

Shi Feng remarked with a bit of emotion.

Some powerful Star Domains have nurtured many Sixth-Level Citizens who naturally vote for their homelands during the Star Alliance conference.

On the contrary, weaker Star Domains, with few Sixth-Level Citizens, can only pay a huge price to seek help from Sixth-Level Citizens of other Star Domains.

The three goddesses are aware of this situation, yet they do not stop it, with the goal of motivating the various Star Domains to cultivate more high-level citizens.

Becoming a high-level citizen doesn’t require one to pioneer an Evolution Path or to engage in research and invention only.

Heading to the Battlefields of Different Races and fighting with Different Species could also earn a lot of Merit Points.

“Let’s take a look at the terms given by the Wangyue Starfield.”

Shi Feng glanced at the piece of White Paper in front of Lin Yuan.

“Wangyue Starfield?”

Lin Yuan thought for a moment. If he remembered correctly, this should be the home Star Domain of the Eighth Layer Evolutionist Ou Yin, shouldn’t it?

“Let me take a look.”

Lin Yuan picked up the White Paper, sharing the view with Shi Feng.

“A Seventh-Rank Soul Defense Treasure,”

Shi Feng was somewhat astonished. The first treasure listed on the White Paper already had him intrigued.

This was a Soul Defense Treasure, essential for guarding the soul, coveted by Evolvers from all Evolution Paths.

“Hmm?”

A thought flickered in Lin Yuan’s mind.

Although he owned an Eighth-Rank Soul Defense Treasure, that one was damaged and the time required for repairing it was unknown.

In the meantime, using a Seventh-Rank Soul Defense Treasure as a substitute would not be a problem.

Lin Yuan wasn’t worried about what to do with the Seventh-Rank Soul Defense Treasure after the Eighth-Rank Soul Defense Treasure was repaired.

Treasures like these, which guard the soul, were never hard to dispose of; Lin Yuan could sell it at a premium whenever he wished.

Lin Yuan’s gaze moved away from the first line on the White Paper.

He looked at the second line.

“Fragment of Jianmu, containing a great amount of life force, capable of remolding the flesh for a Seventh Rank Evolver once.”

Comparing to the Seventh-Rank Soul Defense Treasure, the second item, the fragment of Jianmu, was somewhat less impressive, especially for Lin Yuan, who possessed the ‘Blood Rebirth’ Divine Skill, it’s fairly superfluous.

Yet just because Lin Yuan didn’t need it didn’t mean other Evolvers wouldn’t; it could be sold or traded for other items.

Lin Yuan continued to look at the third line on the White Paper.

“Aquamarine Vishuddha Water, can purify bodily impurities and consolidate the Origin Source of the flesh…”

“`

…

“The Wangyue Starfield is quite sincere…”

After looking at the three treasures, Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

These three treasures were all desirable by Seventh Rank Evolvers, especially the first one.

“I agree to their terms?”

Lin Yuan looked toward Shi Feng with the red nose.

Whether it was the Wangyue Starfield or the Golden Dragon Star Domain,

neither had much to do with Lin Yuan; voting for either side wouldn’t impact Lin Yuan much.

“Don’t rush.”

“Let’s first see what the Golden Dragon Star Domain’s attitude is.”

Having said that, Shi Feng disappeared once again.

When Shi Feng returned, a tall man dressed in a golden robe appeared beside him.

“Jin Tianzhao, that Wangyue Starfield offered a not insignificant price for Shisan’s agreement,you’d have to up your game.”

Shi Feng reminded him.

It was clear,

that the man in the golden robe, named Jin Tianzhao, came from the Golden Dragon Star Domain.

“Mr. Shisan?”

The man in the golden robe, Jin Tianzhao, scrutinized Lin Yuan carefully, “Mr. Shisan, is this your first time attending the Star Alliance conference?”

Jin Tianzhao inquired.

“Indeed it is.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

The Star Alliance conference was held once every hundred years, and for a Sixth-Level Citizen, a century wasn’t that long. Even if some weren’t well-acquainted, they more or less knew each other.

“Since that’s the case, Mr. Shisan, do you know about the strength of my Golden Dragon Star Domain?”

Jin Tianzhao continued to ask.

Upon his inquiry,

Lin Yuan remained unperturbed.

However, Shi Feng frowned, “Jin Tianzhao, what do you mean by that? If you want Shisan to vote for the Golden Dragon Star Domain, then just present your offer, instead of beating around the bush with all that nonsense.”

“Offer?”

Jin Tianzhao shook his head, “I’m here only to meet Mr. Shisan and exchange a few words with him.”

“Mr. Shisan, you have recently become a Sixth-Level Citizen, you shouldn’t make an enemy of my Golden Dragon Star Domain…”

Before Jin Tianzhao could finish,

“Get lost.”

Shi Feng, full of impatience, kicked the other person out of the personal space.

“This Jin Tianzhao is too arrogant. Who is he threatening?”

Shi Feng appeared somewhat agitated, “I thought that the Wangyue Starfield would put some pressure on the Golden Dragon Star Domain, but they came straight with threats?”

“No matter.”

Lin Yuan wasn’t bothered.

If an agreement couldn’t be reached, then there was no need to negotiate.

“I’ll go have a word with that Jin Tianzhao, see where he gets the guts from.”

Shi Feng vanished once again.

…

In another personal space,

Shi Feng glared at the man in the golden robe.

“What do you mean, Jin Tianzhao? Shisan is a friend of mine. Even if you don’t need Shisan’s vote, there’s no need to put it that way.”

Shi Feng’s tone was dissatisfied.

“Shi Feng, you should know, with the strength of my Golden Dragon Star Domain, even if the Wangyue Starfield went around seeking help everywhere, they can’t beat us,”

Jin Tianzhao stated indifferently.

This was the confidence of coming from a powerful star domain.

The Golden Dragon Star Domain, with the Sixth-Level Citizens it cultivated on its own, was the sum of several, or even ten star domains.

“Brother Shi Feng, how long have you known Shisan? You’re this considerate of him already. You… you just like befriending those so-called friends…”

Jin Tianzhao shook his head as he spoke.

“So-called friends?”

Shi Feng’s expression turned peculiar.

“Although Shisan just became a Sixth-Level Citizen, he’s definitely not over a thousand years old. His future potential is limitless. Why else do you think I’d befriend him…”

Shi Feng sighed, “By treating Shisan so disrespectfully, there’s nothing I can do. But in a few thousand or tens of thousands of years, when Shisan has grown stronger, I hope you can still act like you do today…”

“A Sixth-Level Citizen under a thousand years old…”

Jin Tianzhao’s expression shifted slightly, then he calmed down.

“So what…”

“Is he going to become a Seventh-Level Citizen in the future?”

“Even if he becomes a Seventh-Level Citizen, he’s no threat to my Golden Dragon Star Domain.”

“It’s simply that…”

Jin Tianzhao said lightly, “we stay out of each other’s business, that’s all.”

“Stay out of each other’s business?”

Shi Feng gave Jin Tianzhao a glance before turning and leaving.

Stay out of each other’s business?

Who is the insignificant well water,

and who is the boundless river water?

Heaven knows.
